description: Confirms the quote request with the 6-digit code the client received. Rafał gets the request and the client gets a copy of the draft offer by e-mail. One request per address a day.

answers.description: Option ids chosen for the questions of the service (get_quote_questions): q1, q2, q3, when, budget.

description.description: The client's need in their own words (optional). Features it mentions, such as integrations, are priced in.

email.description: The client's e-mail address. A 6-digit code is sent there.

language.description: Language of the texts in the result. Default: en.
